mapper.select: select t1.* from ( select gc.company_id, gc.contract_id, gc.gld_cashflow_id, gc.period_name, gc.start_date, gc.end_date, gc.days, gc.finance_income, gc.source_type, gc.source_id, gc.quotation_id, gc.post_flag, gc.vat_income, gc.cf_item, gc.finance_income_vat, gc.finance_income_includ, gc.finance_income_id from gld_contract_finance_income gc where gc.finance_income_id = #{financeIncomeId} ) t1
select tt.period_name from gld_period tt where tt.period_name = sysdate and rownum=1

SELECT t1.*, round((t1.net_cf_item10 * (1 + t1.vat_rate)), 2) due_cf_item10, (round((t1.net_cf_item10 * (1 + t1.vat_rate)), 2) - t1.net_cf_item10) vat_cf_item10,
round((t1.net_cf_item1 * (1 + t1.vat_rate)), 2) due_cf_item1, (round((t1.net_cf_item1 * (1 + t1.vat_rate)), 2) - t1.net_cf_item1) vat_cf_item1,
round((t1.net_cf_item3 * (1 + t1.vat_rate)), 2) due_cf_item3, (round((t1.net_cf_item3 * (1 + t1.vat_rate)), 2) - t1.net_cf_item3) vat_cf_item3,
round((t1.net_cf_item65 * (1 + t1.vat_rate)), 2) due_cf_item65, (round((t1.net_cf_item65 * (1 + t1.vat_rate)), 2) - t1.net_cf_item65) vat_cf_item65,
round(t1.net_cf_item501 * (1 + t1.vat_rate), 2) AS due_cf_item501, round(t1.net_cf_item501 * (1 + t1.vat_rate), 2) - t1.net_cf_item501 AS vat_cf_item501,
round(t1.net_cf_item69 * (1 + t1.vat_rate), 2) AS due_cf_item69, round(t1.net_cf_item69 * (1 + t1.vat_rate), 2) - t1.net_cf_item69 AS vat_cf_item69
FROM (SELECT (select p.contract_number from con_contract c,prj_project p where c.project_id = p.project_id and c.contract_id = t.contract_id) contract_number, (SELECT c.contract_number FROM con_contract c WHERE c.contract_id = t.contract_id) payment_number, (SELECT c.contract_name FROM con_contract c WHERE c.contract_id = t.contract_id) contract_name, (SELECT m.bp_name FROM con_contract c, hls_bp_master m WHERE c.contract_id = t.contract_id AND c.tenant_id = m.bp_id) bp_name, t.period_name, (SELECT c.vat_rate FROM con_contract c WHERE c.contract_id = t.contract_id) vat_rate, (SELECT SUM(tt.finance_income) FROM gld_contract_finance_income tt WHERE tt.contract_id = t.contract_id AND tt.period_name = t.period_name AND tt.cf_item = 10) net_cf_item10,
(case when (SELECT count(1) FROM gld_contract_finance_income tt WHERE tt.contract_id = t.contract_id AND tt.period_name = t.period_name AND tt.cf_item = 10 AND nvl(tt.post_flag,'N') = 'N')>0 then 'N' when (SELECT count(1) FROM gld_contract_finance_income tt WHERE tt.contract_id = t.contract_id AND tt.period_name = t.period_name AND tt.cf_item = 10 AND tt.post_flag = 'Y') = 0 then 'N' else 'Y' end) as post_flag10,
(SELECT SUM(tt.finance_income) FROM gld_contract_finance_income tt WHERE tt.contract_id = t.contract_id AND tt.period_name = t.period_name AND tt.cf_item = 1) net_cf_item1,
(case when (SELECT count(1) FROM gld_contract_finance_income tt WHERE tt.contract_id = t.contract_id AND tt.period_name = t.period_name AND tt.cf_item = 1 AND nvl(tt.post_flag,'N') = 'N')>0 then 'N' when (SELECT count(1) FROM gld_contract_finance_income tt WHERE tt.contract_id = t.contract_id AND tt.period_name = t.period_name AND tt.cf_item = 1 AND tt.post_flag = 'Y') = 0 then 'N' else 'Y' end) as post_flag1,
(SELECT SUM(tt.finance_income) FROM gld_contract_finance_income tt WHERE tt.contract_id = t.contract_id AND tt.period_name = t.period_name AND tt.cf_item = 3) net_cf_item3,
(case when (SELECT count(1) FROM gld_contract_finance_income tt WHERE tt.contract_id = t.contract_id AND tt.period_name = t.period_name AND tt.cf_item = 3 AND nvl(tt.post_flag,'N') = 'N')>0 then 'N' when (SELECT count(1) FROM gld_contract_finance_income tt WHERE tt.contract_id = t.contract_id AND tt.period_name = t.period_name AND tt.cf_item = 3 AND tt.post_flag = 'Y') = 0 then 'N' else 'Y' end) as post_flag3,
(SELECT SUM(tt.finance_income) FROM gld_contract_finance_income tt WHERE tt.contract_id = t.contract_id AND tt.period_name = t.period_name AND tt.cf_item = 65) net_cf_item65,
(case when (SELECT count(1) FROM gld_contract_finance_income tt WHERE tt.contract_id = t.contract_id AND tt.period_name = t.period_name AND tt.cf_item = 65 AND nvl(tt.post_flag,'N') = 'N')>0 then 'N' when (SELECT count(1) FROM gld_contract_finance_income tt WHERE tt.contract_id = t.contract_id AND tt.period_name = t.period_name AND tt.cf_item = 65 AND tt.post_flag = 'Y') = 0 then 'N' else 'Y' end) as post_flag65,
(SELECT SUM(tt.finance_income) FROM gld_contract_finance_income tt WHERE tt.contract_id = t.contract_id AND tt.period_name = t.period_name AND tt.cf_item = 501) net_cf_item501,
(case when (SELECT count(1) FROM gld_contract_finance_income tt WHERE tt.contract_id = t.contract_id AND tt.period_name = t.period_name AND tt.cf_item = 501 AND nvl(tt.post_flag,'N') = 'N')>0 then 'N' when (SELECT count(1) FROM gld_contract_finance_income tt WHERE tt.contract_id = t.contract_id AND tt.period_name = t.period_name AND tt.cf_item = 501 AND tt.post_flag = 'Y') = 0 then 'N' else 'Y' end) as post_flag501,
(SELECT SUM(tt.finance_income) FROM gld_contract_finance_income tt WHERE tt.contract_id = t.contract_id AND tt.period_name = t.period_name AND tt.cf_item = 69) net_cf_item69,
(case when (SELECT count(1) FROM gld_contract_finance_income tt WHERE tt.contract_id = t.contract_id AND tt.period_name = t.period_name AND tt.cf_item = 69 AND nvl(tt.post_flag,'N') = 'N')>0 then 'N' when (SELECT count(1) FROM gld_contract_finance_income tt WHERE tt.contract_id = t.contract_id AND tt.period_name = t.period_name AND tt.cf_item = 69 AND tt.post_flag = 'Y') = 0 then 'N' else 'Y' end) as post_flag69
FROM gld_contract_finance_income t GROUP BY t.contract_id, t.period_name) t1
1=1
AND t1.period_name = #{periodName}
AND t1.period_name >= #{periodNameFrom}
AND t1.period_name <= #{periodNameTo}
and t1.contract_number like #{contractNumber}
and t1.payment_number like #{paymentNumber}
and t1.contract_name like #{contractName}
and t1.bp_name like #{bpName}
order by t1.contract_number,t1.period_name

select (@i :=@i + 1) as tax_seq, v.* from (select t.* from (select (select pq.first_release_date || '-' || pq.first_release_date from prj_quotation pq where pq.quotation_id = c.quotation_id) period_name, c.contract_id, c.contract_number, c.quotation_id, c.business_type, (select hdt.description from hls_document_type hdt where hdt.business_type = c.business_type and hdt.document_category = 'CONTRACT') business_type_n, c.tenant_id, (select hls.bp_name from hls_bp_master hls where hls.bp_id = c.tenant_id) tenant_id_n, c.contract_status, (SELECT meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.code = 'CON.CONTRACT_STATUS' AND v.code_value = c.contract_status) contract_status_n, (select pq.lease_start_date from prj_quotation pq where pq.quotation_id = c.quotation_id) lease_start_date, (select pq.first_release_date from prj_quotation pq where pq.quotation_id = c.quotation_id) first_release_date, (select pq.lease_term from prj_quotation pq where pq.quotation_id = c.quotation_id) lease_term, (select pq.total_rental from prj_quotation pq where pq.quotation_id = c.quotation_id) total_rental, 0.0005 as stamp_tax, (select pq.total_rental * 0.0005 from prj_quotation pq where pq.quotation_id = c.quotation_id) as stamp_tax_fee, c.stamp_duty_flag
from con_contract c, hls_funding_plan hfp, csh_payment_req_hd cprh WHERE c.contract_id = hfp.contract_id AND hfp.funding_plan_id = cprh.funding_plan_id AND cprh.transfer_status = 'APPROVED' AND EXISTS (SELECT ct.contract_id FROM csh_transaction ct WHERE ct.contract_id = c.contract_id AND ct.transaction_type = 'PAYMENT' AND ct.source_doc_id = cprh.payment_req_id)) t where t.period_name < #{periodName} and t.stamp_duty_flag = 'N'
UNION ALL
select t.* from (select (select pq.first_release_date || '-' || pq.first_release_date from prj_quotation pq where pq.quotation_id = c.quotation_id) period_name, c.contract_id, c.contract_number, c.quotation_id, c.business_type, (select hdt.description from hls_document_type hdt where hdt.business_type = c.business_type and hdt.document_category = 'CONTRACT') business_type_n, c.tenant_id, (select hls.bp_name from hls_bp_master hls where hls.bp_id = c.tenant_id) tenant_id_n, c.contract_status, (SELECT meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.code = 'CON.CONTRACT_STATUS' AND v.code_value = c.contract_status) contract_status_n, (select pq.lease_start_date from prj_quotation pq where pq.quotation_id = c.quotation_id) lease_start_date, (select pq.first_release_date from prj_quotation pq where pq.quotation_id = c.quotation_id) first_release_date, (select pq.lease_term from prj_quotation pq where pq.quotation_id = c.quotation_id) lease_term, (select pq.total_rental from prj_quotation pq where pq.quotation_id = c.quotation_id) total_rental, 0.0005 as stamp_tax, (select pq.total_rental * 0.0005 from prj_quotation pq where pq.quotation_id = c.quotation_id) as stamp_tax_fee, c.stamp_duty_flag
from con_contract c, hls_funding_plan hfp, csh_payment_req_hd cprh WHERE c.contract_id = hfp.contract_id AND hfp.funding_plan_id = cprh.funding_plan_id AND cprh.transfer_status = 'APPROVED' AND EXISTS (SELECT ct.contract_id FROM csh_transaction ct WHERE ct.contract_id = c.contract_id AND ct.transaction_type = 'PAYMENT' AND ct.source_doc_id = cprh.payment_req_id)) t where t.period_name = #{periodName}) v,(SELECT @i := 0) AS row_seq

select v.*, (v.due_amount - (select sum(gcf.FINANCE_INCOME) from gld_contract_finance_income gcf where gcf.PERIOD_NAME < v.PERIOD_NAME and gcf.cf_item = 501 and gcf.contract_id = v.contract_id)) balance_amount from (select t.finance_income_id, t.company_id, t.cf_item, t.contract_id, t.gld_cashflow_id, t.period_name, to_date(t.start_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') start_date, to_date(t.end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') end_date, t.days, t.finance_income, t.source_type, t.source_id, t.quotation_id, t.post_flag, t.vat_income, (select pqc.deposit_interest_rate from prj_quotation_cashflow pqc where pqc.cf_item = 501 and pqc.cf_type = 5 and pqc.QUOTATION_ID = c.QUOTATION_ID) deposit_interest_rate, (select pqc.deposit_interest_flag from prj_quotation_cashflow pqc where pqc.cf_item = 501 and pqc.cf_type = 5 and pqc.QUOTATION_ID = c.QUOTATION_ID) deposit_interest_flag, (select pqc.due_amount from prj_quotation_cashflow pqc where pqc.cf_item = 501 and pqc.cf_type = 5 and pqc.QUOTATION_ID = c.QUOTATION_ID) due_amount, (select last_day(t.end_date) from dual) amortization_date, t.finance_income_includ, t.finance_income_vat, (select hls.bp_name from hls_bp_master hls where c.tenant_id = hls.bp_id) bp_name, (select p.project_name from prj_project p, prj_project vc where vc.project_id = c.project_id and p.project_id = vc.ref_project_id) project_name, (select vc.contract_number from prj_project vc where vc.project_id = c.project_id) vc_contract_number, (select vc.contract_number from prj_project vc where vc.project_id = c.project_id) vc_contract_name, c.contract_number, (select vc.finance_amount from prj_project vc where vc.project_id = c.project_id) finance_amount, (select to_date(pq.lease_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') from prj_quotation pq where pq.quotation_id = c.quotation_id) incept_date, c.vat_rate, (select fc.company_full_name from fnd_company fc where fc.company_id = t.company_id) company_full_name, nvl(t.pre_post_flag, 'N') as pre_post_flag
from gld_contract_finance_income t left join con_contract c on c.contract_id = t.contract_id) v
1=1 and v.contract_id = #{contractId} and v.cf_item = 501 and v.gld_cashflow_id = #{gldCashflowId}
order by v.start_date asc

select fil.attributes_1 AS contract_number, fil.attributes_2 AS cf_item_n, fil.attributes_3 AS times, fil.attributes_4 AS period_name, to_date(fil.attributes_5, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_date, to_date(fil.attributes_6, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS end_date, to_number(fil.attributes_7) AS days, to_number(fil.attributes_8) AS finance_income from fnd_interface_lines fil header_id = #{headerId}
and line_number !=0
